column7: BulkApproveAccessRequests/BulkRejectAccessRequests (routes gated on roles.assign anywhere) answered "permission denied" per item for a request in a project where the approver lacks roles.assign and "access request not found" for a missing ID, so a project-scoped approver could list which request IDs exist in other projects. Both now answer "access request not found"; a failure to resolve the approver's authority is reported separately (fails closed). AUTHZ-ORACLE-1 item 2 sweep
